name: auxtools
description: Debug BYOND worlds with breakpoints, stepping, variable inspection and hot reload.

auxtools.byondPath.markdownDescription: The BYOND installation directory, which contains `bin`. Leave it empty to find BYOND automatically.

auxtools.launcherPath.markdownDescription: A launcher to use instead of the bundled `auxtools` launcher. Leave it empty to use the bundled one.

auxtools.debugLibrary.markdownDescription: A debug library to use instead of the bundled one: `debug_server.dll` on Windows or `libdebug_server.so` on Linux. Leave it empty to use the bundled library.

auxtools.addToTerminalPath.markdownDescription: Add the launcher's directory to `PATH` in VS Code terminals, so that `auxtools` commands work there.

auxtools.autoJoin.markdownDescription: Join launched worlds with DreamSeeker automatically, on Windows. These clients reconnect after a reboot.

auxtools.closeDreamSeeker.markdownDescription: Close the clients that the extension opened when their world process ends.

reconnect.description: Offer to reconnect players after a skin or client script reload.

join.description: Offer to join a world that the extension didn't join automatically, or to copy its address when DreamSeeker is not available.

rebuild.description: Warn when changes need a reboot or a rebuild.

outdated.description: Warn about edits that may be missing from the build.

dme.description: The project's .dme file. Default: the .dme beside the .dmb. Its directory is the source root.

enumDescriptions: Console DreamDaemon (dd.exe on Windows), with output in the Debug Console
Windowed DreamDaemon (Windows), with output in its own window
Host and join the world in DreamSeeker (Windows)
server.description: The program that runs the world. Default: DreamDaemon (dd.exe on Windows).

defines.description: The defines that the world was built with: NAME, NAME=VALUE or DreamMaker -D arguments. The extension adds the flags selected in SS13 Build Flags for matching build tasks. With older versions of SS13 Build Flags, it uses the selected flags only when defines is not set.

hotReload.description: Reload supported source changes on save, including when running without debugging.

sleepingThreads.description: The most sleeping procs to list in the Call Stack view while the world is paused.

byondPath.description: The BYOND installation to use, instead of auxtools.byondPath or automatic discovery.

port.description: The port the world listens on. Without it, DreamDaemon chooses a free port when it starts.

args.description: Arguments to put after the .dmb. They replace the default arguments: -trusted, and also -close for dreamdaemon-gui on Windows.

debugLibrary.description: The debug library for this launch, instead of auxtools.debugLibrary. If neither is set, the extension uses its own library.

processId.description: The world's process ID. Without it, you select a running world that has the debugger loaded.

dme.description: The project's .dme file, if it is not the one beside the running .dmb.

defines.description: The defines that the world was built with: NAME, NAME=VALUE or DreamMaker -D arguments. Without them, the extension uses the flags selected in SS13 Build Flags, if it is installed. Set [] to turn this off.

hotReload.description: Reload source changes when you save. Off by default when you attach, so that your reloads don't compete with those of the session that launched the world.

sleepingThreads.description: The most sleeping procs to list in the Call Stack view while the world is paused.
